headword: {期待|きたい}を{膨|ふく}らます
gloss: to build up one's expectations; to get one's hopes up

definitions.gloss: to build up one's expectations; to get one's hopes up
definitions.explanation: To let one's anticipation or hopes grow larger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませている→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧。
examples.english: I'm building up my expectations for the new job.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{遠足|えんそく}→遠足：04107_ensoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませていた→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧。
examples.english: The children were getting excited about the field trip.

examples.japanese: ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませ→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦がっかりする→がっかりする：21758_gakkarisuru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you build up your expectations too much, you might end up disappointed.

notes:
A vivid idiomatic expression that uses the image of expectations swelling or inflating like a balloon. ⟦{膨|ふく}らます→膨らます：09646_fukuramasu⟧ means "to inflate" or "to swell," creating a physical metaphor for growing anticipation. Very commonly used in the て form as ⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませて→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧ (with expectations swelling).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませる→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧: to build up expectations (ichidan variant, also common)
- ⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませる→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧: to have one's heart swell with expectation
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませる→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧: to let one's dreams grow

COMMON PATTERNS:
Both ⟦{膨|ふく}らます→膨らます：09646_fukuramasu⟧ (godan) and ⟦{膨|ふく}らませる→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧ (ichidan) are used. The ichidan form ⟦{膨|ふく}らませる→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧ is more common in modern usage, especially in the て form (⟦{膨|ふく}らませて→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{期待|きたい}する→期待する：06065_kitaisuru⟧: to expect, to look forward to — neutral and straightforward
- ⟦{楽|たの}しみにする→楽しみにする：26825_tanoshiminisuru⟧: to look forward to — emphasizes pleasure and excitement
- {待|ま}ち{望|のぞ}む: to eagerly await — more literary and formal
